title: Extend the current environment and compose runs
description: Native descriptor authoring, run creation and revision, worker-environment ownership and verification boundaries.
applicability: Use when a task needs a new tool, MCP connection, interface, worker environment, run, or a change to its current capabilities.

content.text: Inspect the installed descriptors and the actual authoring tools before choosing an implementation. Extend an existing owner through its descriptor when possible. New code belongs to an interface or worker-environment package. Prepare and validate exact file effects; preserve accepted work. Publish reusable instructions and capability selections back into an authorized collection after the capability exists.
